invariants.rationale: Partition is used as an argument and as a key, so it should not be null.
Partitioner is immediately cast and used for method invocation; thus, it should not be null.
recordItr is passed into downstream handlers, so it is likely expected to be non-null.
instantTime is required to uniquely identify the commit instant in Hudi, so null would likely be invalid.
partitioner is directly cast to JavaUpsertPartitioner at the beginning of the method.
